pushA:shoulder-press.coach: Stay at 15 kg and aim for 8: every set was 7 last time.

pushA:incline-db-press.coach: Same 10 kg: every set was 7, one under the range, so aim for 8.

pushA:cable-lateral.coach: Drop to 5 kg on another cable station since 5 to 6 reps at 10 kg is far under 12; start with the left arm.

pushA:chest-fly.coach: Up one step to 30 kg: both sets reached 15.

pushA:triceps-pushdown.coach: Up one step to 22.5 kg: every set reached 15.

pushA:db-lateral.coach: Drop to 3 kg: 9 reps at 5 kg was far under 15.

pullA:pull-up.coach: Work at 30 kg on every set: you got 12 there, so aim for 10 on all four.

pullA:cable-row.coach: Stay at 20 kg and aim for 12: every set was 10.

pullA:straight-arm-pulldown.coach: Stay at 20 kg and aim for 14: every set was 12.

pullA:reverse-fly.coach: Drop to 5 kg since 6 reps was far under 12, and switch to face pulls if the shoulder hurts again.

pullA:cable-lateral.coach: Drop to 5 kg on another cable station since 5 to 6 reps at 10 kg is far under 12; start with the left arm.

pullA:curl.coach: Stay at 5 kg with longer rests: your sets fell to 7, 6 and 4, under 8.

legsA:leg-press.coach: Empty sled again and aim for 12: every set was 10.

legsA:rdl.coach: Stay at 20 kg: the first set of 6 held you back, so aim for 10 on all three.

legsA:leg-curl.coach: Stay at 20 kg and aim for 12: every set was 10.

legsA:leg-extension.coach: Same 10 kg, slow, aim for 12, and stop if the knee hurts.

legsA:standing-calf.coach: Stay at 20 kg and aim for 12: both sets were 10.

legsA:hanging-knee-raise.coach: Bodyweight again and aim for 12: both sets were 10.

pushB:incline-press.coach: First time: pick a weight you can press about 8 times with 2 reps left, the empty bar or a light machine setting.

pushB:shoulder-press.coach: Stay at 15 kg and aim for 8: last time every set was 7.

pushB:db-lateral.coach: Drop to 4 kg: 9 reps at 5 kg was under 12.

pushB:dips.coach: First time: bodyweight dips leaning forward, or the chest press machine at a weight you can lift 10 times.

pushB:overhead-triceps.coach: First time: pick a rope weight you can lift about 12 times with 2 reps left, lighter than your 20 kg pushdown.

pushB:cable-lateral.coach: Drop to 5 kg on another cable station since 10 kg gave only 5 to 6 reps; start with the left arm.

pullB:lat-pulldown.coach: First time on this line: start near the 30 kg you pulled 12 times on Pull A.

pullB:chest-supported-row.coach: First time: pick a weight you can row about 10 times with 2 reps left; your 20 kg cable row is a guide.

pullB:one-arm-row.coach: First time: pick a dumbbell you can row 12 times per arm with 2 reps left; start with the left arm.

pullB:face-pull.coach: First time: a light rope weight for about 15 reps, elbows high, and stop if the shoulder hurts.

pullB:cable-lateral.coach: Drop to 5 kg on another cable station since 5 to 6 reps at 10 kg is far under 12; start with the left arm.

pullB:hammer-curl.coach: First time: pick dumbbells you can curl about 12 times with 2 reps left.

legsB:split-squat.coach: First time: bodyweight or light dumbbells for about 10 reps per leg, and stop if the spot below the left kneecap hurts.

legsB:hip-thrust.coach: First time: pick a weight you can lift about 10 times with 2 reps left.

legsB:leg-curl.coach: Stay at 20 kg and aim for 12: every set was 10.

legsB:seated-calf.coach: First time: pick a weight you can lift about 15 times with 2 reps left.

legsB:hanging-leg-raise.coach: First time: bodyweight, and bend the knees a little if 10 straight-leg reps are not there.
